question.text: The total number of sp2 hybridised carbon atoms in the major product P (a non-heterocyclic compound) of the following reaction is

solution.text: Lithium aluminium hydride is a strong reducing agent. It reduces cyanide to primary amine with no loss of carbon. Primary amine can undergo nucleophilic addition reaction with acetophenone to produce imine derivative. The carbon with one pi bond are sp2 hybridised carbon. All the carbon in benzene ring are sp2 hybridised. Hence, totally 28 sp2 carbon are present in the molecule.
